_README: Hand-kept service-time exceptions for restricted-list spells the roster
feed cannot tell apart on wording alone.
THE DEFAULT (rules v7): a 'placed ... on the restricted list' transaction
STOPS the service clock. Under MLB Rule 2(c)(6) and the standard glossaries
a restricted-list player is not paid and earns no Major League service.
scripts/service_time.py (_STOP_RE) treats the placement as a stop and a
later 'activated/reinstated ... from the restricted list' as a start.
THE EXCEPTIONS: a few restricted-list spells DO earn service -- paid
domestic-violence administrative leave and the 2020 high-risk COVID
opt-outs -- and a few that look like a leave in the feed are actually an
unpaid suspension that earns none. The feed phrases all of these
identically ('placed ... on the restricted list'), so they cannot be told
apart from the text; each is recorded here by hand with a public source.
counts=true  -> the period IS credited as Major League service (unioned
into the player's active intervals, then clipped to the
season windows). Use for paid administrative leave and the
2020 opt-outs.
counts=false -> the period is NOT credited (cut out of the active
intervals). Use for a suspension the feed shows only as a
restricted-list placement. Redundant where the default stop
already handles it, but kept for the record and its source.
This is a reference list of settled, sourced facts -- the same discipline
as config/cba/roy_full_year_awards.json and data/super_two_reported.json.
An entry that cannot cite a public source is not entered.
FIELDS (all required; scripts/service_time_exceptions.py validates them and
is exercised by tests/test_service_time.py, so CI fails on a malformed
file): mlbam_id (the MLB person id, the only stable key -- never match by
name), name (for humans), start and end (inclusive ISO dates YYYY-MM-DD,
end >= start), counts (true/false), reason, source (one https URL or a list
of them).

exceptions.name: Trevor Bauer
exceptions.reason: Paid administrative leave under the MLB/MLBPA Joint Domestic Violence, Sexual Assault and Child Abuse Policy, beginning 2021-07-02 and continuing (the feed records it as a restricted-list placement) until the suspension took effect 2022-04-29. A player on paid administrative leave keeps his salary and his Major League service, so his 2021 season is full and his 2022 is credited from the Dodgers' Opening Day (Apr 8) through Apr 28.

exceptions.name: Trevor Bauer
exceptions.reason: Suspension under the Joint Domestic Violence Policy, effective 2022-04-29 (originally 324 games, reduced to 194 by an arbitrator but upheld and served). The transaction feed carries no separate suspension row -- it shows only the restricted-list placement -- so this records that the time earns no service. The default restricted-list stop already produces this; the entry is kept for the record and the source.
